content:
The **Sole Survivor** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update. It was made available for crafting via a Daily Ops plan with the *Fallout Worlds* update.

## Gameplay[edit]

The Sole Survivor is a legendary lever action rifle, whose default configuration consists of a forceful stock, suppressor, and long night vision scope. It also has a unique default paintwork with the phrase "This is not the end" on the stock in front of the reload handle and trigger, and numerous tick marks counting kills inscribed on the stock. It works similar to regular lever actions rifles, and can use all lever action rifle modifications as well.

## Variants[edit]

## Locations[edit]

Can be crafted at any Weapons Workbench after learning the plan.

A unique legacy version of the Sole Survivor was a reward for completing the weekly challenge of "Complete Events (0/20)" in the now-defunct Survival mode. It was available in 2019, from April 9–15, and July 16–23.

## Behind the Scenes[edit]

This weapon's name has the same name as the *Fallout 4* protagonist, the Sole Survivor.
